exercises.prompt: 求 $f(x)=2x$ 在 $\mathbb R$ 上的全部原函数，并解释为什么它们只差常数。
exercises.answer: $F(x)=x^2$ 满足 $F'=2x$，所以全部原函数为 $x^2+C$。若 $G'=2x$，则 $(G-F)'=0$；在连通区间 $\mathbb R$ 上由中值定理得 $G-F$ 为常数。

exercises.prompt: 用第二类换元 $x=\sin t$ 求 $\int dx/\sqrt{1-x^2}$（$-1<x<1$）。

exercises.prompt: 计算不定积分$I = \int arctan\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}}\, dx(a > 0)$ .
exercises.answer:
用分部积分法:$\begin{array}{r} I = xarctan\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}} - \int x \cdot \frac{1}{1 + \frac{a - x}{a + x}} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}}} \cdot \frac{- 2a}{(a + x)^{2}}dx \\ \quad = xarctan\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}} + \frac{1}{2}\int\frac{x}{\sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}}}dx \\ \quad = xarctan\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}} - \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}} + C.\quad ▫ \end{array}$
解2令$x = acost$,则有
$\arctan\sqrt{\frac{a - x}{a + x}} = arctan\sqrt{\frac{1 - cost}{1 + cost}} = arctan\sqrt{\frac{2\sin^{2}\frac{t}{2}}{2\cos^{2}\frac{t}{2}}} = arctan(tan\frac{t}{2}) = \frac{t}{2}.$
因此
$\begin{array}{r} I = a\int\frac{t}{2}dcost = a \cdot \frac{t}{2}cost - \frac{a}{2}\int costdt \\ \quad\quad = \frac{at}{2}cost - \frac{a}{2}sint + C \\ \quad\quad = \frac{x}{2}\arccos\frac{x}{a} - \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - x^{2}} + C.\quad ▫ \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 设对自然数 $m,n$ , 定义 $I(m,n) = \int\cos^{m}x\sin^{n}x\, dx$ , 证明:$I(m,n) = \frac{\cos^{m - 1}x\sin^{n + 1}x}{m + n} + \frac{m - 1}{m + n}I(m - 2,n).$
exercises.answer:
用分部积分法得到:$\begin{array}{r} I(m,n) = \int\cos^{m}x\sin^{n}xdx = \int\cos^{m - 1}x\sin^{n}xd(sinx) \\ = \cos^{m - 1}x\sin^{n + 1}x - \int sinxd(\cos^{m - 1}x\sin^{n}x), \end{array}$
而最后一个积分可以计算如下
$\begin{matrix} \int sinxd(\cos^{m - 1}x\sin^{n}x) \\ = \int sinx\lbrack - (m - 1)\cos^{m - 2}x\sin^{n + 1}x + n\cos^{m}x\sin^{n - 1}x\rbrack dx \\ = - (m - 1)\int\cos^{m - 2}x(1 - \cos^{2}x)\sin^{n}xdx + n\int\cos^{m}x\sin^{n}xdx \\ = - (m - 1)I(m - 2,n) + (m + n - 1)I(m,n), \end{matrix}$
加以整理并除以 $m + n$ 即得所要的递推公式.

exercises.prompt: 导出求不定积分 $I_{n} = \int\frac{dx}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}}$ ( $n$ 是自然数)、的递推公式.
exercises.answer:
解由分部积分法,我们有$\begin{matrix} I_{n} = \int\frac{dx}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} = \frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} + 2n\int\frac{x^{2}}{(1 + x^{2})^{n + 1}}dx \\ = \frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} + 2n\int\left( \frac{1}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} - \frac{1}{(1 + x^{2})^{n + 1}} \right)dx \\ = \frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} + 2nI_{n} - 2nI_{n + 1}, \end{matrix}$
因此得到递推公式$I_{n + 1} = \frac{1}{2n} \cdot \frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})^{n}} + \left( 1 - \frac{1}{2n} \right)I_{n},\quad n \in N_{+}.\quad ▫$

exercises.prompt: 求不定积分 $\int\frac{xarctanx}{(1 + x^{2})^{2}}dx.$
exercises.answer:
将分部积分法和换元法结合起来就很容易解决这个积分问题. 首先用分部积分法计算如下:$\begin{array}{r} \int\frac{xarctanx}{(1 + x^{2})^{2}}dx = - \frac{1}{2}\int arctanxd\left( \frac{1}{1 + x^{2}} \right) \\ = - \frac{arctanx}{2(1 + x^{2})} + \frac{1}{2}\int\frac{darctanx}{1 + x^{2}}. \end{array}$
然后对最后一个积分用代换 $arctanx = t$ ,就有
$\begin{array}{r} \frac{1}{2}\int\frac{darctanx}{1 + x^{2}} = \frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dt}{1 + \tan^{2}t} \\ = \frac{1}{2}\int\cos^{2}tdt = \frac{1}{4}\int(cos2t + 1)dt \\ = \frac{1}{8}sin2t + \frac{1}{4}t + C \\ = \frac{1}{4}\frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})} + \frac{1}{4}arctanx + C. \end{array}$
合并以上结果就得到
$\begin{array}{r} \int\frac{xarctanx}{(1 + x^{2})^{2}}dx = - \frac{arctanx}{2(1 + x^{2})} + \frac{1}{4}\frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})} + \frac{1}{4}arctanx + C \\ = \frac{1}{4}arctanx\left( \frac{x^{2} - 1}{x^{2} + 1} \right) + \frac{1}{4}\frac{x}{(1 + x^{2})} + C. \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 求不定积分 $\int\frac{xlnx}{(1 + x^{2})^{2}}dx.$
exercises.answer: $\begin{array}{r} \int\frac{xlnx}{(1 + x^{2})^{2}}dx = - \frac{1}{2}\int lnxd\left( \frac{1}{1 + x^{2}} \right) \\ \quad\quad = - \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{lnx}{1 + x^{2}} - \int\frac{1}{1 + x^{2}}dlnx \right) \\ \quad\quad = - \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{lnx}{1 + x^{2}} - \int\frac{dx}{x(1 + x^{2})} \right) \\ \quad\quad = - \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{lnx}{1 + x^{2}} - \int\left( \frac{1}{x} - \frac{x}{1 + x^{2}} \right)dx \right) \\ \quad\quad = - \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{lnx}{1 + x^{2}} - lnx + \frac{1}{2}ln(1 + x^{2}) \right) + C \\ \quad\quad = - \frac{1}{2}\frac{lnx}{1 + x^{2}} + \frac{1}{4}\ln\frac{x^{2}}{1 + x^{2}} + C \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r} I = \int\csc^{2}xd( - cotx) = - cotx\csc^{2}x + \int cotxd(\csc^{2}x) \\ = - cotx\csc^{2}x - 2\int(\csc^{4}x - \csc^{2}x)dx \\ = - cotx\csc^{2}x - 2I - 2cotx, \end{array}$
因此得到 $I = - \frac{1}{3}cotx\csc^{2}x - \frac{2}{3}cotx + C.$

exercises.prompt: 将 $\frac{1}{1 + x^{3}}$ 化为部分分式的和.
exercises.answer: 对待定的表达式$\frac{1}{1 + x^{3}} = \frac{1}{(1 + x)(1 - x + x^{2})} = \frac{A}{1 + x} + \frac{Bx + C}{1 - x + x^{2}}$两边同乘以 $1 + x$ 后,令 $x \rightarrow - 1$ ,得$A = \frac{1}{3}$ .又将(9.1)两边同乘以 $x$ 后,令 $x \rightarrow + \infty$ ,得 $A + B = 0$ ,因此$B = - A = - \frac{1}{3}$.再在(9.1)两边用$x = 0$代入,得$1 = A + C$ ,因此 $C = 1 - A = \frac{2}{3}$ .

令$u = 1 + x$ ,则$x = u - 1$ ,因此$\begin{array}{r} \int\frac{1 - x^{3}}{(1 + x)^{4}}dx = \int\frac{1 - (u - 1)^{3}}{u^{4}}du = \int\left( - \frac{1}{u} + \frac{3}{u^{2}} - \frac{3}{u^{3}} + \frac{2}{u^{4}} \right)du \\ = - ln|u| - \frac{3}{u} + \frac{3}{2u^{2}} - \frac{2}{3u^{3}} + C \\ = - ln|x + 1| - \frac{3}{x + 1} + \frac{3}{2(x + 1)^{2}} - \frac{2}{3(x + 1)^{3}} + C. \end{array}$
形如$\int\frac{Q_{m}(x)}{(x^{2} + px + q)^{n}}dx$的积分, 其中分母无实根, $Q_{m}(x)$为 $m$ 次多项式. 这时可用带余除法将 $Q_{m}(x)$ 化成 $Q_{m - 2}(x)(x^{2} + px + q)$ 与一个余项的和, 如果$m - 2 \geq 2$ , 继续对 $Q_{m - 2}(x)$ 作带余除法,直到其次数小于2(例题从略).

记被积函数为 $R(x)$ . 首先要分离出真分式, 得到$R(x) = x + \frac{x^{5} - x^{4} + x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 2x}{(x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)^{2}}.$根据部分分式理论, 一定有唯一的分解如下:$\frac{x^{5} - x^{4} + x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 2x}{(x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} = \frac{A}{(x - 1)^{2}} + \frac{B}{x - 1} + \frac{Cx + D}{(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} + \frac{Ex + F}{x^{2} + 1}.$
两边同乘以 $(x - 1)^{2}$ 后令 $x \rightarrow 1$ , 就得到 $A = - 1$ . 又两边同乘以 $(x - 1)^{2}$ 后求在点 $x = 1$ 处的导数值, 则就可用求导法则计算如下:$B = \frac{(5 - 4 + 3 - 6 - 2) \cdot 4 - 8 \cdot (1 - 1 + 1 - 3 - 2)}{16} = 1.$又在 (9.2) 两边同乘以 $(x^{2} + 1)^{2}$ , 再令 $x \rightarrow i$ (复数域中的极限), 就得到$Ci + D = \frac{i - 1 - i + 3 - 2i}{- 2i} = 1 + i,$因此 $C = D = 1$ . 再在 (9.2) 两边令 $x = 0$ 代入,得到$A - B + D + F = 0$,因此$F = 1$.最后在 (9.2) 两边同乘以 $x$ , 并令 $x \rightarrow + \infty$ , 就得到 $1 = B + E$ , 因此 $E = 0$ . 以下的积分没有困难, 我们只列出结果为$\int R(x)dx = \frac{1}{2}x^{2} + \frac{1}{x - 1} + \frac{x}{2(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} + ln|x - 1| + \frac{3}{2}arctanx + C.$代替用各种手段去确定 (9.2) 中的未知数的思路, 另外还有一种方法值得介绍, 它看似笨拙, 实际上往往很有效 (见 [68]).
解2 写出(9.2)并求出 $A = - 1$ 之后,将右边这一项移到左边,计算出
$\begin{array}{r} \frac{x^{5} - x^{4} + x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 2x}{(x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} - \frac{- 1}{(x - 1)^{2}} = \frac{x^{5} + x^{3} - x^{2} - 2x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} \\ = \frac{x^{4} + x^{3} + 2x^{2} + x - 1}{(x - 1)(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} = \frac{B}{x - 1} + \ldots, \end{array}$
然后就容易求出 $B = 1$ 。再将这第一项移到左边,计算得到
$\begin{array}{r} \frac{x^{4} + x^{3} + 2x^{2} + x - 1}{(x - 1)(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} - \frac{1}{x - 1} = \frac{x^{3} + x - 2}{(x - 1)(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} = \frac{x^{2} + x + 2}{(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} \\ = \frac{x + 1}{(x^{2} + 1)^{2}} + \frac{1}{x^{2} + 1}, \end{array}$
以下从略.

exercises.prompt: 求不定积分 $\int\frac{dx}{1 + x^{4}}$ .
exercises.answer:
令 $M(x) = \int\frac{dx}{1 + x^{4}},N(x) = \int\frac{x^{2}dx}{1 + x_{1}^{4}}$ ,则有$\begin{array}{r} M(x) - N(x) = \int\frac{1 - x^{2}}{1 + x^{4}}dx = - \int\frac{1 - \frac{1}{x^{2}}}{x^{2} + \frac{1}{x^{2}}}dx \\ = - \int\frac{d\left( x + \frac{1}{x} \right)}{\left( x + \frac{1}{x} \right)^{2} - 2} = - \frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\frac{x^{2} - \sqrt{2}x + 1}{x^{2} + \sqrt{2}x + 1} + C, \end{array}$
$\begin{matrix} M(x) + N(x) = \int\frac{1 + x^{2}}{1 + x^{4}}dx = \int\frac{1 + \frac{1}{x^{2}}}{x^{2} + \frac{1}{x^{2}}}dx = \int\frac{d\left( x - \frac{1}{x} \right)}{\left( x - \frac{1}{x} \right)^{2} + 2} \\ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\arctan\frac{x - \frac{1}{x}}{\sqrt{2}} + C = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\arctan\frac{x^{2} - 1}{\sqrt{2}x} + C, \end{matrix}$
因此得到
$\begin{array}{r} M(x) = \frac{1}{2}\left\lbrack (M(x) + N(x)) + (M(x) - N(x)) \right\rbrack \\ = - \frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}}\ln\frac{x^{2} - \sqrt{2}x + 1}{x^{2} + \sqrt{2}x + 1} + \frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\arctan\frac{x^{2} - 1}{\sqrt{2}x} + C. \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 计算 $I = \int\sin^{4}xdx.$
exercises.answer:
用分部积分法可进行如下:$\begin{array}{r} I = - \int\sin^{3}xdcosx = - \sin^{3}xcosx + \int cosxd\sin^{3}x \\ = - \sin^{3}xcosx + 3\int\sin^{2}x\cos^{2}xdx \\ = - \sin^{3}xcosx + 3\int\sin^{2}x(1 - \sin^{2}x)dx \\ = - \sin^{3}xcosx + 3\int\sin^{2}xdx - 3\int\sin^{4}xdx \\ = - \sin^{3}xcosx + \frac{3}{2}\int(1 - cos2x)dx - 3I \\ = - \sin^{3}xcosx + \frac{3}{2}x - \frac{3}{4}sin2x - 3I, \end{array}$
所以得到 $I = - \frac{1}{4}\sin^{3}xcosx + \frac{3}{8}x - \frac{3}{16}sin2x + C.$ 
解2
$\begin{array}{r} I = \int\left( \frac{1 - cos2x}{2} \right)^{2}dx = \frac{1}{4}\int(1 - 2cos2x + \cos^{2}2x)dx \\ = \frac{1}{4}\int\left( 1 - 2cos2x + \frac{1 + cos4x}{2} \right)dx \\ = \frac{3}{8}x - \frac{1}{4}sin2x + \frac{1}{32}sin4x + C.\quad ▫ \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 设对自然数$n > 2$,定义$I_{n} = \int\frac{sinnx}{sinx}dx$,证明:$I_{n} = \frac{2}{n - 1}sin(n - 1)x + I_{n - 2}.$
exercises.answer:
考虑降n,$\begin{array}{r} I_{n} = \int\frac{sin(n - 1)xcosx + sinxcos(n - 1)x}{sinx}dx \\ = \int\frac{sin(n - 1)xcosx}{sinx}dx + \int cos(n - 1)xdx \\ = \frac{1}{2}\int\frac{sinnx + sin(n - 2)x}{sinx}dx + \int cos(n - 1)xdx \\ = \frac{1}{2}I_{n} + \frac{1}{2}I_{n - 2} + \frac{1}{n - 1}sin(n - 1)x, \end{array}$
所以$I_{n} = \frac{2}{n - 1}sin(n - 1)x + I_{n - 2}.$

exercises.answer:
将根号外的一个因子 $x$ 移入到根号下, 并将积分表达式看成为 $f(u)du$ , 其中$u = x^{2}$, 就可计算如下:$\begin{array}{r} I = \frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{x^{4} + x^{2}}dx^{2} = \frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{\left( x^{2} + \frac{1}{2} \right)^{2} - \left( \frac{1}{2} \right)^{2}}d\left( x^{2} + \frac{1}{2} \right) \\ = \frac{1}{4}\left( x^{2} + \frac{1}{2} \right)\sqrt{x^{4} + x^{2}} - \frac{1}{16}\ln\left( x^{2} + \frac{1}{2} + \sqrt{x^{4} + x^{2}} \right) + C_{1} \\ = \frac{1}{8}x(2x^{2} + 1)\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} - \frac{1}{16}ln(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1})^{2} + C\quad\left( C = C_{1} + \frac{ln2}{16} \right) \\ = \frac{1}{8}x(2x^{2} + 1)\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} - \frac{1}{8}ln(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}) + C.\quad ▫ \end{array}$
解2因为 $\int x\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}dx = \frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}d(x^{2} + 1) = \frac{1}{3}(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} + C_{1},$ 所以由分部积分法,可得
$\begin{array}{r} I = \frac{1}{3}\int xd(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} = \frac{1}{3}x(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{1}{3}\int(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}}dx \\ = \frac{1}{3}x(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{1}{3}\int(x^{2} + 1)\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}dx \\ = \frac{1}{3}x(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{1}{3}\int x^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}dx - \frac{1}{3}\int\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}dx \\ = \frac{1}{3}x(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{I}{3} - \frac{1}{6}\left( x\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} + ln(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}) \right). \end{array}$
将 $\frac{1}{3}I$移项到左边,且对两边同除以 $\frac{4}{3}$ ,得到$I = \frac{1}{4}x(x^{2} + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \frac{1}{8}\left( x\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} + ln(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}) \right) + C.$本题还有下列解法, 这种解法虽然不容易想到, 但十分简洁.
解3 因为
$\left( x^{3}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} \right)^{\prime} = 3x^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} + \frac{x^{4}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}} = 4x^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} - \sqrt{x^{2} + 1} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}},$
所以$x^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} = \frac{1}{4}\left( \left( x^{3}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} \right)^{\prime} + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}} \right).$于是$I = \frac{1}{4}\left( x^{3}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} + \frac{x}{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1} - \frac{1}{2}ln(x + \sqrt{x^{2} + 1}) \right) + C$

exercises.prompt: 计算 $I = \int\frac{dx}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}.I = \int\frac{dx}{x^{2}\sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)^{2}}} = - \int\frac{d\left( \frac{1}{x} \right)}{\sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)^{2}}} = - arcsin\frac{1}{x} + C.$
exercises.answer:
这是第一换元法, 在其中将 $1/x$ 看成为 $u$ , 将被积表达式看成 $\frac{du}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}$ , 然后用基本积分公式. 但实际上也可以说是用第二换元法. 令 $x = 1/t$ , 这时$dx = - \frac{1}{t^{2}}dt,\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}} = \frac{t^{2}}{\sqrt{1 - t^{2}}},$于是就有$I = - \int\left( \frac{1}{t^{2}} \right) \cdot \frac{t^{2}}{\sqrt{1 - t^{2}}}dt = - \int\frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^{2}}},$以下与解1相同. 这个解法中的变换称为“倒代换”,是一种常用的变量代换. 更一般的还有代换 $x = t^{\alpha}$ ,其中 $\alpha$ 待定.
解2 $I = \int\frac{xdx}{x^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}} = \int\frac{d\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}{(\sqrt{x^{2} - 1})^{2} + 1} = arctan\sqrt{x^{2} - 1} + C.$ 
解3 令 $x = sect$ ,则 $dx = secttantdt,I = \int\frac{secttant}{secttant}dt = \int dt = t + C = arccos\frac{1}{x} + C.$
解4 令 $\sqrt{x^{2} - 1} = x - t$ ,则可解出 $x = (t^{2} + 1)/2t$ ,并计算得到$dx = \frac{t^{2} - 1}{2t^{2}}dt,\sqrt{x^{2} - 1} = \frac{1 - t^{2}}{2t}.$因此$\begin{array}{r} I = \int\frac{2t \cdot 2t(t^{2} - 1)}{(t^{2} + 1)(1 - t^{2})2t^{2}}dt = - 2\int\frac{dt}{1 + t^{2}} \\ = - 2arctant + C = - 2arctan(x - \sqrt{x^{2} - 1}) + C. \end{array}$
解5 令 $\sqrt{x^{2} - 1} = t(x - 1)$ , 则可解出 $x = (t^{2} + 1)/(t^{2} - 1)$ , 并计算得到$dx = - \frac{4tdt}{(t^{2} - 1)^{2}},\sqrt{x^{2} - 1} = \frac{2t}{t^{2} - 1}.$因此$\begin{array}{r} I = \int\frac{(t^{2} - 1)^{2}( - 4t)}{(t^{2} + 1)2t(t^{2} - 1)^{2}}dt = - 2\int\frac{dt}{1 + t^{2}} \\ = - 2arctant + C = - 2arctan\frac{\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}{x - 1} + C \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 求 $\int dx/\sqrt{x^2+4}$，并核对所得原函数在全实数上有定义。
exercises.answer: 可令 $x=2\sinh t$，化为 $\int dt=t+C$；因此结果为 $\operatorname{arsinh}(x/2)+C=\log(x+\sqrt{x^2+4})+C'$。因为 $\sqrt{x^2+4}>|x|$，对数真数始终为正；求导得原被积函数。

exercises.prompt: 求二项微分式 $\int x(1+x^2)^{3/2}\,dx$。
exercises.answer: 取 $u=1+x^2>0$，$du=2x\,dx$，于是积分为 $\frac12\int u^{3/2}du=\frac15(1+x^2)^{5/2}+C$。这是二项微分式可有理化处理的简单情形。

exercises.prompt: 计算不定积分 $I = \int\frac{1 - \sqrt{x + 1}}{(x + 1)(1 + \sqrt[3]{x + 1})}dx.$
exercises.answer: 令 $t = \sqrt[6]{x + 1}$ , 则 $x = t^{6} - 1$ , $dx = 6t^{5}dt$ . 因此$\begin{matrix} I = \int\frac{6(1 - t^{3})t^{5}}{t^{6}(1 + t^{2})}dt = 6\int\frac{1 - t^{3}}{t(1 + t^{2})}dt \\ = 6\int\frac{(1 + t^{2}) - t(t - 1) - t(1 + t^{2})}{t(1 + t^{2})}dt = 6\int\left( \frac{1}{t} - \frac{t - 1}{t^{2} + 1} - 1 \right)dt \\ = 6\left( ln|t| - \frac{1}{2}ln(1 + t^{2}) + arctant - t \right) + C \\ = 6\left( \ln\sqrt[6]{x + 1} - \frac{1}{2}ln(1 + \sqrt[3]{x + 1}) + arctan\sqrt[6]{x + 1} - \sqrt[6]{x + 1} \right) + C \\ = 3ln\frac{\sqrt[3]{x + 1}}{1 + \sqrt[3]{x + 1}} + 6arctan\sqrt[6]{x + 1} - 6\sqrt[6]{x + 1} + C.\quad ▫ \end{matrix}$

exercises.prompt: 计算不定积分 $\int\frac{1}{x}\sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}}\, dx$ .
exercises.answer: 令$t = \sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}}$ ,则$x = \frac{2(t^{2} + 1)}{t^{2} - 1}$ ,$dx = - \frac{8t}{(t^{2} - 1)^{2}}dt.$ 因此$\begin{array}{r} \int\frac{1}{x}\sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}}dx = \int\frac{4t^{2}}{(1 - t^{2})(1 + t^{2})}dt \\ \quad\quad = 2\int\left( \frac{1}{1 - t^{2}} - \frac{1}{1 + t^{2}} \right)dt = ln\left| \frac{1 + t}{1 - t} \right| - 2arctant + C \\ \quad\quad = ln\left| \frac{1 + \sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}}}{1 - \sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}}} \right| - 2arctan\sqrt{\frac{x + 2}{x - 2}} + C \\ \quad\quad = ln|x + \sqrt{x^{2} - 4}| + arctan\left( \frac{\sqrt{x^{2} - 4}}{2} \right) + C \end{array}$

exercises.prompt: 在每个不跨越 $x=-1$ 的区间上求 $\int[x e^{x^2}+1/(x+1)]\,dx$，说明两部分所用方法。
exercises.answer: 首项以 $u=x^2$ 凑微分，积分为 $\frac12e^{x^2}$；第二项是简单分式，积分为 $\log|x+1|$。故总结果为 $\frac12e^{x^2}+\log|x+1|+C$，常数可随连通区间而异。
